scripts.title: Auto click
scripts.script:
getgenv().Enabled = true -- false to disable
-------------------------------------------
while getgenv().Enabled == true do
task.wait()
workspace.Events.AddClick:FireServer()
end
scripts.features:
Auto clickers can be as simple as a program that simulates mouse clicking. This type of auto clicker is fairly generic and will often work alongside any other computer program running at the time and acting as though a physical mouse button is pressed.
More complex auto clickers can similarly be as general, but often are custom-made for use with one particular program and involve memory reading. Such auto clickers may allow the user to automate most or all mouse functions, as well as simulate a full set of keyboard inputs. Custom-made auto clickers may have a narrower scope than a generic auto clicker. Sometimes, an auto clicker may not deliver the amount of clicks as entered because of the limitations of the software it is being used on.

scripts.title: script by Aidez on v3rmillion
scripts.features:
Silent Aim, Anti-Stomp, Auto-Eat, AntiCheat Bypass

Original: https://v3rmillion.net/showthread.php?tid=1184858

Profile: https://v3rmillion.net/member.php?action=profile&uid=482542

COMMANDS CAN BE DONE AS /e command OR :command
PLAYERNAMES CAN BE EITHER A DISPLAY NAME OR A ROBLOX NAME
OTHERS, ALL, and ME CAN BE USED AS A STANDIN FOR COMMANDS THAT TAKE PLAYERNAMES

:silentaim - Always hit the head of the player closest to your mouse.
:unsilentaim - Turns off silentaim

:oneshot - Automatically repeats any landed shots until the target dies. (Doesn't actually one shot, just makes it so you only need to shoot them once manually.)
:unoneshot - Turns off oneshot.

:killaura - Shoots at anyone close to you
:unkillaura - Turns off killaura

:autoeat - Eats food when you're injured
:autoeat NUMBER - Sets what health autoeat should start eating at (defaults to healing after any damage)
:unautoeat - Turns off autoeat

:autogetup - Eats food until you get up whenever you're ragdolled
:unautoget - Turns off autogetup

:antistomp - Stops you from being stomped, and lets you move around while you're ragdolled
:unantistomp - Turns you back into a cripple

:autoarrest - If you're on the cop team, this'll automatically arrest any downed criminals near you.
:unautoarrest - Turns off autoarrest

:superrun - Makes you super fast while holding shift
:unsuperrun - Turns off superrun


X Key: Heal / Eat food

L Key: Toggle super run
- Key: Lower super run speed
+ Key: Increase super run speed


!! PRESS ' TO TYPE IN COMMAND BAR !!
